captions.caption: A man carries a metal nesting box outside.
The camera pans over the grassy yard area.
A man holds a board over the metal box.
He marks the board with a pen.
The man continues marking the board's edge.
He finishes marking and lifts the board.
Close-up of a reciprocating saw on wood.
The saw starts cutting through the board.
The man guides the saw along the line.
Sawdust flies as the blade cuts wood.
The cutting process continues steadily.
The saw moves further down the marked line.
The blade continues slicing through the wood.
The man maintains control of the saw.
The cut is halfway through the board.
Sawdust accumulates on the wooden surface.
The saw reaches the lower half of the board.
The man's hands steady the wood.
The saw approaches the end of the line.
The blade cuts through the final section.
The two wood pieces separate as the cut finishes.
He sets down the saw and picks up pieces.
He examines the cut wooden boards.
He enters a chicken coop carrying the box.
The man walks past chickens inside the coop.
He places the nesting box on a stand.
He reaches for a drill near the box.
View of the metal box inside the coop.
He moves toward the coop's wall frame.
He prepares a wooden panel for installation.
He holds the board against the frame.
He positions the board over an opening.
Chickens and a goose wander in the background.
The man checks the board's alignment.
He prepares to screw the board in place.
He holds a screw ready for the drill.
He positions the drill against the board.
The drill drives a screw into the wood.
The screw enters the frame through wood.
He finishes driving the first screw.
He reaches for another screw.
He prepares the drill for the next spot.
He positions the second screw on the board.
The drill starts spinning again.
He drives the second screw into the frame.
The board is now partially secured.
He moves to the next board corner.
The drill drives a third screw.
He positions a fourth screw.
The drill secures the board's top part.
He continues fastening the wall panel.
The screw is fully driven into the wood.
He steps back to inspect the board.
He looks at the camera and talks.
The man addresses the viewer in the coop.
He gestures toward the nesting box.
Close-up of the metal nesting box.
He points at nesting box features.
He reaches into a nesting compartment.
He explains the nesting box function.
